subtitle: Your guitar deserves proper protection. From basic gig bags to professional flight cases, learn how to choose the right protection for your instrument and playing situation.

introduction.title: Why Proper Protection Matters
introduction.text: A quality case costs much less than repairing damage. Proper protection preserves your guitar's value, playability, and appearance for years to come.

columns.title: Common Guitar Damage
columns.text: Finish Damage: Scratches, dents, and chips. Structural Issues: Cracks in body or neck. Hardware Problems: Bent tuners, damaged electronics. Environmental: Temperature and humidity damage. Impact Damage: Drops and collisions.

columns.title: Protection Benefits
columns.text: Value Preservation: Maintains resale value. Playability: Prevents setup and intonation issues. Peace of Mind: Transport without worry. Professional Image: Organized and prepared appearance. Storage: Safe keeping between sessions.
